# Seoungbeom Na (나승범)

> Assistant Professor of Smart Architecture and Civil Engineering at Hanyeong University (Yeosu, Korea). Research on real options–based feasibility, quantitative risk analysis, renewable energy development, and smart construction.

## About
Ph.D. in Construction Management (Chosun University, 2025). Applies real options theory and Monte Carlo–based risk analysis to the economic feasibility of renewable energy and large-scale construction projects. Since Aug 2026, Head of the Planning Team at Hanyeong University.

## Research areas
- Economic feasibility assessment and investment valuation (real options; renewable energy, energy plants, and unconventional oil and gas development)
- Quantitative risk analysis (construction cost volatility, country risk, causal modeling)
- Uncertainty quantification and stochastic simulation (stochastic price processes, Monte Carlo methods)
- Smart construction (drone/LiDAR 3D mapping, airborne bathymetric LiDAR, digital transformation)

## Selected publications (SCI, first author on all six)

- Modeling the Causal Relationships of Country Risk Factors Using Expert Experience and Intuition-based Sensing Data. Sensors and Materials 37(9):3929-3947, 2025. https://doi.org/10.18494/SAM5596
- Economic Feasibility and Strategic Planning for Floating Solar Power Plants in Korea: A Real Options Approach. Sustainability 17(1):137, 2025. https://doi.org/10.3390/su17010137
- Analyzing Spatial Differences in Construction Risk Management. Sensors and Materials 36(9):4043-4059, 2024. https://doi.org/10.18494/SAM5349
- Real Options Analysis for Land and Water Solar Deployment in Idle Areas of Agricultural Dam. Sustainability 14(4):2297, 2022. https://doi.org/10.3390/su14042297

## Case pages (detailed findings per article)
- /case-railway-solar.html  Railway solar, scale flexibility under SMP and REC uncertainty (Energies, in press)
- /case-offshore-wind.html  Geumil offshore wind 600 MW: NPV -313.7M USD, B/C 0.87, expansion option 69.6M USD, REC weight breakeven 3.01
- /case-floating-solar.html Gunsan floating solar 100 MW: NPV +11.86M USD, B/C 1.1, expansion option 93.18M USD
- /case-agrivoltaics.html   Naju agricultural dam 1 MW land + 35 MW water: NPV -6.67M USD, abandonment option adds 44.83M USD
- /case-country-risk.html   PLS-SEM on 93 expert responses: environmental risk has the largest direct effect on cost overrun (beta = 0.360)
- /case-spatial-risk.html   21 country risk factors compared across the Middle East, Asia, and the Arctic
- /case-water-dx.html       Water industry roadmap from 58 expert responses: sector priority is natural environment management and prediction, water supply and customer service, water intake and resource facilities, water purification
